# Score-mask codegen audit

Uninstrumented release binaries;static instruction counts are not executed costs.
Original cross-word predicate retained. Width0 bypass and width64 behavior checked
by scalar bitstream oracle;no branch removal claim about baseline mask (it uses select).

## Interpretation

A/C iterator instructions and addresses match after normalizing four panic-literal
relocations. Their full linked disassemblies differ elsewhere; do not claim identical
binaries or infer an intrinsic C advantage from screening. Both use neg/mov/lsr/and
for the mask instead of baseline mov/lsl/cmp/csinv/and. B uses a different arithmetic
sequence without reducing total iterator instruction count. Static count alone does
not prove runtime benefit; fresh primary threshold failed and all variants remain parked.
